Thanks Jordan — I'm on it. Quick notes from an initial read of the trace:

- The request shows a connection reset halfway through the token stream from upstream (we see a truncated chunk at ~560 tokens). That's consistent with a proxy-level timeout if keepalives aren't forwarded.
- SDK v1.8.2 has a known behavior where the node client will fire a 3-attempt retry by default for 5xx and network errors; with large streaming responses this can lead to overlap if the upstream actually completes while the client times out.

Repro plan (what I'll run before Thursday):
1) Run the sample-payload.json direct against hosted endpoint (no proxy) using node SDK v1.8.2 and our latest internal CLI to capture full HTTP/TLS traces.
2) Re-run with a simple HTTP proxy (small timeouts) to emulate your internal edge and see if we hit reset/502.
3) Toggle SDK retry and per-request timeout (set timeout to 90s, retries=1) and rerun with identical payload to measure success rate.

If I can reproduce, I'll capture a minimal playbook with recommended settings: SDK flags, suggested proxy timeout, and a batching/size threshold for reranker calls.

Also attaching a short troubleshooting checklist in the drive link.

Nina / team — quick update ahead of the 09:00 session:

- I reproduced a 502 locally when proxy introduced a 10s idle timeout while the host was streaming. The server (hosted) actually completed the response; the proxy closed the connection mid-stream which results in an upstream 502 surface to client and triggers SDK retry.
- Short-term mitigations: increase proxy idle timeout to 60s for reranker routes; set SDK per-request timeout to 90s and reduce max retries to 1. This prevents duplicate billing and reduces load during transient network resets.
- Long-term: consider using chunked transfer/keepalive passthrough in proxy; or switch to structured output with smaller candidate batches (e.g., split into groups of 4-5).

I'll bring exact curl and node repro commands to the call and share the minimal logs (repro-trace-20271103.log) plus a patched sample script.

See you at 09:00 PT — joining link: https://meet.redwood.ai/steerwell-deepdive-20271104
